text:
maria_g: Heads up — content drop for the Redwood webinar next Tue. Need: X thread rollout, LinkedIn carousel, 30s clip, and short follow-up PM script. Who can own which asset? :rocket:

ton y_l: I can take the carousel + do the short clip edit. Will need final copy + hero image by EOD Fri.

ben_o: I'll wire the benchmark narrative and lead routing. Quick Q — are webinar registrants going straight to SDR queue or do we funnel via the 5-question qualifier?

maria_g: Prefer qualifier first. We want to filter for trial fit. So: registrants -> qualifier form -> high-score -> SDR queue #2, others -> nurture drip. Ben, can you map the routing in Growth ops?

ben_o: Yep. Routing plan: ``registrants.csv columns: email,score,interest_level`` then: ``if score>=8 -> SDR-queue-2``; else tag "nurture_2026_launch". I'll add to the runbook.

figma-design: Linked Figma file — https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/redwood-launch-assets — can you confirm hero safe area? Tony, I left two comp sizes in the file.

tony_l: Saw it. Using comp B for carousel (1200x1200) and comp A for clip thumbnail. Will export web-optimized PNGs. ETA Fri 5pm PT.

jess_p: Scheduling note — prefer we stagger X thread as 3 posts over 20 mins to capture live engagement, then push LinkedIn 10 mins after final X post. Sam-bot can queue drafts if we give exact UTC times.

sam-bot: Drafts queued — please confirm times. Proposed: ``Tue 15:00 UTC: X post 1``; ``Tue 15:08 UTC: X post 2``; ``Tue 15:20 UTC: X post 3``; ``Tue 15:30 UTC: LinkedIn carousel``.

maria_g: Those times look good. Ben, can you add a lead capture CTA on post 2 (short link to qualifier)? Use short.redwood.ai/qualify

ben_o: Added CTA and UTM params. Also prepping a 1-paragraph benchmark stat to include in post 1: "Redwood reduced per-token latency variance by 3x in customer A's gen pipeline" — will refine wording.

tony_l: Quick ask for copy: can we get 1 headline and 3 short CTAs for the carousel cards? Example: "Predictable LLM inference at scale" / "See the benchmark" / "Join the webinar"

maria_g: I'll draft headline + 3 CTAs by EOD Thu. Also writing the reply script for comments: short, friendly, + link to recording/qualifier. Jess — can you own comment follow-ups for 48hrs?

jess_p: Yep. I'll use this template for replies: "Thanks! If you're curious about latency/cost tradeoffs, here's a quick form to share a bit about your use case -> short.redwood.ai/qualify". I'll batch responses hourly. :white_check_mark:

sam-bot: Reminder set: review final assets 30m before scheduled posts.

maria_g: Perfect. Final checklist: 1) Tony assets in Figma + exports (Fri 5pm PT), 2) Ben routing + CTA + benchmark copy (Thu EOD), 3) Maria copy + CTAs (Thu EOD), 4) Jess follow-ups (post-live). If anything slips, flag here and we'll move schedule 1 day.

tony_l: A few micro-asks for export: include transparent PNG for clip thumbnail, and 16:9 crop for video. I'll add export presets in figma.

ben_o: I'll drop the UTM mapping into the runbook: ``utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=webinar_launch_may2026``

maria_g: Thanks all. Quick test: can someone post one line of the first X post copy here so I can approve tone?

ben_o: "We built an inference platform that makes LLMs predictable — lower latency, lower cost. Join our 45-min webinar to see the numbers. -> short.redwood.ai/qualify"

maria_g: Nice. Slight tweak: replace "lower cost" with "clear unit economics" — more precise.

ben_o: Updated: "We built an inference platform that makes LLMs predictable — lower latency, clear unit economics. Join our 45-min webinar to see the numbers. -> short.redwood.ai/qualify"

jess_p: Approved for tone. I'll prep reply pins.

maria_g: Great. I'll assemble the posting package and ping when drafts are loaded. :eyes:
